posts.text: [Image] The image presents a bar graph illustrating job creation trends since January. It shows that the private sector has added 654,000 jobs, while federal government jobs have decreased by 277,000, resulting in a net loss of 181,000 government jobs. The graph is labeled with "More Private Sector Jobs" and "Fewer Government Jobs," and it cites sources from the Bureau of Labor Statistics and the Council of Economic Advisers.
